Kpi.description: One verified metric from the first result row. Business data must bind @Evidence(id).

Col.description: Vertical layout. Root must be Col.

Row.description: Wrapping row; stacks on narrow screens.

Grid.description: Responsive grid with up to four columns.

Card.description: Solid result panel with a title.

Math.description: LaTeX math, with no HTML trust.

Button.description: Local @Set/@Reset or @ToAssistant action. id must be unique.

IconButton.description: Accessible labelled icon action, unique id.

Pressable.description: A labelled button wrapping content, unique id.

Input.description: Reactive text or numeric input; first arg usually $variable.

Select.description: Choose an option, bound to a $variable.

SegmentedControl.description: Choose an option, bound to a $variable.

RadioGroup.description: Choose an option, bound to a $variable.

Timer.description: Start, pause and reset countdown; seconds are local state.

Form.description: Group fields; submit via Button @ToAssistant. No direct mutations.

SearchImage.description: Public Wikimedia photo search. Literal public terms only; no evidence or form variables.

Image.description: Public Wikimedia upload image only, with alt text.

Table.description: Records with optional selected columns. Business data must use @Evidence(id).

Chart.description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut or scatter chart of records. Business data must bind @Evidence(id).

Map.description: Public itinerary map. Static public locations only; driving route optional.

MapMarker.description: Public place. Static latitude/longitude, no business bindings.

YouTube.description: Open a public YouTube video without embedded tracking.

Celebration.description: A short success announcement; respects reduced motion.

Svg.description: Responsive vector diagram. Coordinates use its viewBox.

HtmlView.description: Self-contained HTML/canvas with inline scripts only. No network, parent access or business evidence. Include accessible controls and a text description.

Append.description: Append an item to a list.

Range.description: Inclusive numeric range, at most 1000 values.

Percent.description: Percent of total; null for zero denominator.

Payment.description: Loan payment; rate is per period.

Convert.description: Convert with an explicit factor and offset.

Format.description: Format a number with fraction digits and optional ISO currency.

MixColor.description: Mix named Nova tokens with a CSS color-mix expression.

AddMonths.description: Add months, clamped to the target month.

StartOf.description: UTC start of day, Monday-based week, month or year.

Pivot.description: Sum a numeric field by group and category, within this result only.

Top.description: Top n records by numeric field.

Between.description: Filter records inclusively by numeric field.

Stats.description: Count, sum, mean, min, max, median of this list.

Evidence.description: Read immutable verified result records by exact evidence id. Local filters/aggregates cover only these rows.
